package.name: mower_cameras
package.description: Minimal V4L2 camera driver for the Airseekers Tron mower. Opens the front Metoak stereo module (/dev/videoSimor -> video11, side-by-side frames) and the rear USB UVC camera (/dev/rear_camera -> video62) via cv2.VideoCapture and publishes /vio/left, /vio/right and /rear_camera as sensor_msgs/Image (bgr8, or mono8 when mono:=true), plus optional JPEG CompressedImage streams on <topic>/compressed. No cv_bridge: frames cross the OpenCV/ROS boundary as raw bytes.
